goal: Operator order 2026-11-01: understand the recent phases FIRST, then decide how to backtest. Phase 1 (design set, look freely): walk the recent BTC 15m/1h from the 60k low through the 87k top to now; mark every H1, L1, held retest, L1 sweep, H1 take-out and the drop after, with time of day (US session), OI change during the retest, WaveTrend/RSI divergence at H1 and the nearest volume node; a dated table plus chart screenshots. note: Operator 2026-11-01 HEDGE framing: the legs are not each a trade to judge alone. Core = the position on the main idea (e.g. short from H1 for the final drop); hedge = a temporary opposite position on the leg against it (e.g. long into the held-retest / H1 take-out), closed when that leg plays out, because the reversal back to the core idea is expected. Score the BOOK, not the legs: core alone vs core + hedge on net P&L after fees.py fees on every leg, max adverse excursion, and core stop-outs avoided. A hedge leg with gross about 0 (C26 arm A) can still pay if it lets the core survive the squeeze; it is a NO if the extra fees exceed the drawdown it saves. Execution note for Phase 2: a same-venue hedge in one-way mode just nets the position (needs hedge mode, a second venue, or options); testnet only. | Operator 2026-11-01 (chat) CANDIDATE C, martingale short inside a range: after a held high is taken in a DOWN regime, short in steps on RSI bearish divergence on 1m, 2m, 3m and 5m (each new leg larger, martingale), WaveTrend and, where it helps, OI and CVD as filters; no per-leg stop INSIDE the range, where the range = H1 up to the level beyond which price rarely goes before reversing. Lab_Guy framing (OURS until frozen): the range top IS the stop for the whole ladder (all legs out there), because a martingale with no outer stop has unbounded loss and the doubled legs make the range-break loss the largest of the series. Phase 1 design numbers: DOWN-high take-outs overshoot 0.37 % median, 0.65 % at the 80th pct (4h), so about 1 in 5 take-outs leave a 0.65 % range. Measure first (design window, logged): max adverse excursion above H1 BEFORE the close back under H1 / back to L1, per regime; 1m-5m RSI divergence count per take-out. Then freeze: range top, leg count, size multiplier (OURS), exits (back to L1 / close under H1 / 24h). Score the BOOK on DEV 2022-04..2024-06: net after fees.py on every leg, worst loss when the range breaks, ruin frequency, vs the single-entry short (Candidate A). CVD from 1m kline taker-buy volume (available in DEV); OI from 5m metrics. Param tuning only on the recent design window, every variant in the trial registry; DEV decides. | Lab_Guy 2026-11-01 MEASURED (PHASE1_RANGE.md, card c26-range-ladder, design window SEEN): DOWN highs n=30, 60 % back to L1 <=24h; those went 0.37 % median / 0.64 % 80th / 2.28 % max beyond H1 first; the 40 % that did not ran 1.06 % median. Range top X=1.0 %: 21/30 inside, 16 of them reach L1, 9 stopped (2 false); X=0.65 %: 17 inside (15 reach L1), 13 stopped (3 false). 1m-5m RSI divergence legs are a clock, not a filter: 83-96 % of take-outs had one, median 8-16 signals per window, first 12-63 min after the break at 0.14-0.24 % above H1. Revalidation (C26_REVALIDATION_2026-11-01.md): divergence shorts and ladders already tested negative repo-wide; the edge candidate is the STATE (DOWN-regime take-out reverses), so Candidate A is the gate and C/B are book variants scored against it. DEV is a seen period for C26 (arms A/B read all history): Phase 3 = first look on DEV 2022-04..2024-06 + one look 2024-07..2026-06, clean test forward. Next: c26-phase2-freeze-regime-ladder, c26-phase3-dev-book. | Operator 2026-11-01 (chat) CANDIDATE C2, nested ladder: a martingale inside the first range (H1..+0.65 %), continued in the 1.0 % and 1.5 % tiers, each tier bigger; one stop at the outer top. Lab_Guy design look (PHASE1_RANGE.md Q3, phase1_ladder_look.py, 30 DOWN-high take-outs, gross unit-% with fees.py per leg): single short +0.35 per unit of margin (worst -1.49); flat 3 legs +0.20; martingale 1-2-4 +0.15; nested flat +0.09; nested martingale 1/2/4 +0.03 (worst -10.10 on 14 units). All shapes reach L1 in 16-17 of 30: a ladder changes the bet size on that count, not the count. Six shapes logged; Phase 3 tests A first, ladders against it.
